description: This file defines the OpportunitiesViewEdit class that overrides default behavior in the Opportunities module's edit view in SuiteCRM. It adds custom scripting to dynamically update the probability field based on the sales stage selection.

classes.name: OpportunitiesViewEdit
classes.description: A subclass of ViewEdit that adds custom scripting for the Opportunities module's edit view, particularly to handle sales probability updates based on sales stage.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that calls parent constructor and sets useForSubpanel flag.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Overrides the display method to insert custom JavaScript for updating the probability field when the sales stage changes.
